tools.name: get-status
tools.title: Get Fronius Status
tools.description: Read current inverter, energy, Smart Meter, battery, Ohmpilot, and power-flow data.

ai.instructions: Treat Fronius data as read-only. Call get-status before answering questions about current production, consumption, grid flow, battery, Smart Meter, Ohmpilot, inverter state, or errors. Use site.pvPowerWatts for current production. An inverter's connectedPvPowerWatts is configured connected PV capacity, not realtime output. State the timestamp and units when they matter. Treat null values and partialDataWarnings as unavailable data. Do not invent error-code meanings, forecasts, savings, trends, or optimization claims from a single snapshot. If the returned data does not support an answer, say what is missing and suggest the Fronius manual or a qualified installer. Never claim to change inverter settings.
